Apple releases new iPhone wallpapers every year, and you can download the new ones added in iOS 27 here. However, iOS 27 also adds the ability to create your own wallpapers. Here's how to do it.

Here's how to create your own wallpaper in iOS 27

This year, as part of the overall major AI improvements in iOS 27, Apple has overhauled its Image Playground app.

Image Playground now offers more powerful image generation capabilities, with far fewer restrictions than before. It can even let you create perfectly sized wallpaper images.

However, you don't even need to open the Image Playground app to create wallpapers.

iOS 27 lets you create your own iPhone wallpaper directly in the wallpaper picker.

Go to "Settings" → "Wallpaper" → "Add New Wallpaper", or long-press the Lock Screen and tap the "+" button to open the iOS 27 wallpaper gallery.

This year, a new Image Playground option has been added to the top of the gallery. iOS 27 will also automatically add some AI-generated images to the featured wallpaper section.

For example, you'll see suggested wallpapers based on your own photos but with a new style applied.

During my time testing iOS 27, my iPhone automatically created stunning styled versions of several of my favourite photos for me without any effort required, and they looked great as wallpapers.

Throughout the gallery, wherever you see an AI-generated wallpaper, Apple's new Image Playground icon will appear next to it, so you know exactly where the image came from.

If you like one of Apple's suggested AI wallpapers, just select it and you're done.

However, iOS 27 also lets you tap the Image Playground button at the top to create fully customised wallpapers yourself. Image Playground will ask you to describe the image you want, and you can choose a style, or base it on existing photos or people.

After the image is generated, it's automatically sized perfectly for use as an iPhone wallpaper.

Have you tried iOS 27's new wallpaper creation tools? Let us know in the comments.
